_comment: Sample run config for gen-prompts.py --group shared --families SH-OLD (a box below on-prem 26, here on Preview, review fix F-05, 2026-10-27). One config per shared family: the engine has one tenant per config, and each family runs on another shared tenant (group.json env.tenants). Run sample01 and the paths are fakes. Named by the user / the box owners in gate SH-G3, fake here: tenant (the < 26 box, Preview or CT host, never polypointservices.ch), OLDHP1 / OLDHP2 logins (same personnel category), OLD_POMA_API (poma-api URL of that Preview stage; none on CT, with STAGE ct). Supplied by the runner, fake here: CRED_FILE (the runner's 0600 file for OLDHP1 / OLDHP2, outside results/), PIDOPS_PROFILE and PORTAL_PROFILE (headed ops sign-ins, outside results/). OLD_DAY = a future weekday with a swappable presence of OLDHP1 (seed SH1 step 5). bundle / bundle_class n/a unless known. Test: gen-prompts.py <this file> --group shared --families SH-OLD --dry-run (exit 0, no NEEDS CONFIG line).
